props.name: multiSelect
props._description: Allows more than one option to be chosen at a time.

props.name: isArray
props._description: Stores the selection as an array rather than a single scalar. Normally paired with `multiSelect`.

props.name: static

staticProps.name: staticOptions

text.name: text
text._description: Labelled "Value to Save" in the source — the value written to the form data when this option is chosen. Note the field name and its label read as opposites; see the quirks section.

value.name: value
value._description: Labelled "Text to Display" in the source — the text shown to the user for this option. Note the field name and its label read as opposites; see the quirks section.

text.name: text
text._description: Labelled "Value to Save" in the source — the value written to the form data when this option is chosen. Note the field name and its label read as opposites; see the quirks section.

value.name: value
value._description: Labelled "Text to Display" in the source — the text shown to the user for this option. Note the field name and its label read as opposites; see the quirks section.

staticProps._description: The authored option rows used when `static` is true. Note the prop's own `name` is `staticOptions` even though the key is `staticProps`.

props._description: `true` means the option list is authored here, in `staticProps`. `false` means options arrive at runtime from a data source or event handler.

props.name: selectFirstRecord
props._description: Pre-selects the first option as soon as the list loads, instead of starting empty.

props.name: dynamic
props._description: Marks the option list as runtime-bound. Counterpart of `static`; the two are mutually exclusive.

props.name: disabled
props._description: Greys the control out and blocks all interaction — it cannot be focused, clicked or edited. It still occupies its grid slot.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.

props.name: hasParent
props._description: Makes this a dependent list, filtered by the selection of a parent dropdown — a country/state style cascade.
